methodology.scope: All 29 attack captures with supplied injection intervals (13 fabrication, 13 derived masquerade, 3 fuzzing). Full basic_short ambient capture is baseline-only. First 120 seconds each of basic_long and extended_short ambient captures are held out for normal evaluation. The paired fabrication/masquerade captures share underlying recordings.
methodology.threshold_selection: Existing application default, fixed before this run; no tuning on evaluated captures
methodology.prior_development: The repository documents previous rule development using Car-Hacking. These are preliminary development results, not a pristine held-out benchmark.
methodology.positive_window: At least one frame labeled attack by the existing loader
methodology.road_labels: Metadata injection interval and injected CAN ID; fuzzing labels every frame in the interval. This is interval/ID-derived window ground truth, not exact injected-frame annotation.
methodology.explanation_evaluation: Not evaluated in this detection benchmark
methodology.empty_windows: Excluded by the existing feature extractor
methodology.window_tail: Existing extractor may include one partially observed final 0.5 s window; no records beyond the selected interval are added
methodology.aggregation: Pool window confusion counts across selected evaluation captures; overlapping windows and related captures are not independent samples
methodology.interface: Command-line evaluation; browser upload does not yet supply separate baseline captures and ROAD metadata
methodology.capture_dependence: HCRL attack files have identical final 100 source lines; ROAD fabrication/masquerade pairs share underlying captures. Pooled per-file windows are not independent samples.
